meta.source: Extracted from the Movemental home hero canvas (Home-Final and the Resolution screens), October 2026

tokens.name: ground
tokens.usage: Page background everywhere. The site is white; there is no dark theme.

tokens.name: sheet
tokens.usage: The paper a Resolution is written on, callout panels, the share preview box. Text on it uses ink or graphite.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: All primary text, the primary button fill, signature lines, completed marks.

tokens.name: body-muted
tokens.usage: Long explanatory paragraphs under a heading, signer lines. Slightly softer than ink, still 11:1 on ground.

tokens.name: graphite
tokens.usage: Captions, counts, theme labels, quiet secondary links. 6.5:1 on ground, 6.1:1 on sheet. Never for body copy longer than two lines.

tokens.name: rule
tokens.usage: Hairlines between rows, input and card borders. Decorative only: never the sole boundary of a control a person must find (inputs pair it with a label).

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: Ultramarine. Focus rings, the current theme mark, the line just starred, one live highlight at a time. 8.6:1 on ground. Never a background for long text.

tokens.name: accent-tint
tokens.usage: Selected-row wash and the chosen option in a group. Ink text on it.

tokens.name: field
tokens.usage: The dark network field behind the movement-leader figure on the home page. Ground-colored text on it.

styles.name: display-xl
styles.usage: The home hero and the close only. 64px on a phone.

styles.name: display-l
styles.usage: Section openers on the home page.

styles.name: display-m
styles.usage: Page titles inside the flow. 40px on a phone.

styles.name: display-s
styles.sample: Someone has to ask the human questions

styles.name: sheet-title
styles.usage: The first line of a Resolution document.

styles.name: question
styles.sample: Where must a person always be present in our work?
styles.usage: Questions put to a reader or a working group.

styles.name: statement
styles.sample: We should keep the moments of care human.
styles.usage: A statement on a Resolution sheet. Statements are always set in the reading face.

styles.name: reading-l
styles.sample: Added together, those decisions are already a response.
styles.usage: Home page body and lead paragraphs.

styles.name: reading
styles.sample: We should say plainly how AI is used here.
styles.usage: Statements in lists and count rows.

styles.name: reading-s
styles.sample: Your note, your Resolution’s lines and what you’ll do.
styles.usage: Previews of what someone else will see; explanatory notes.

styles.name: ui-l
styles.usage: Form text, inputs, primary interface copy.

styles.name: ui-s
styles.sample: Only people you share this with can see it.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Theme labels beside statements, small metadata. Graphite.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Between a label and its hint.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Between a label and its field.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Row padding in count lists and statement lists.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Between related controls; panel inner gaps.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Between groups inside a section.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections on a flow page.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Desktop page gutter and header inset. 20px on a phone.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Page bottom padding; between home sections.

tokens.name: radius-sheet
tokens.usage: The Resolution sheet and sheet panels: paper, nearly square.

tokens.name: radius-field
tokens.usage: Inputs, difference cards, small boxes.

tokens.name: radius-card
tokens.usage: Home page cards and figures.

tokens.name: radius-dialog
tokens.usage: Dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Buttons and switches. Every button is a pill.

tokens.name: target-min
tokens.usage: Minimum height of any clickable line, link button or checkbox row.

tokens.name: button-height
tokens.usage: Primary button height.

tokens.name: measure-sheet
tokens.usage: Widest a Resolution sheet runs.

tokens.name: measure-flow
tokens.usage: Max width of a single-column flow page.
